title: Further Deposit Computation — Room Reservations Resort Deposits
content:
## Computation

For a Room Reservations resort reservation guaranteed by an advance deposit:

1. **Money held** is every deposit collected for the reservation less every refund, forfeit and transfer of deposit money posted on it, read from the reservation's charge records.
2. **Deposit the reservation requires** is the plan's resort deposit nights of the nightly rate on the reservation, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate: the plan's resort deposit nights multiplied by the nightly rate on the reservation, multiplied by one plus the hotel's tax rate.
3. **Further deposit** is the deposit the reservation requires less the money held, never below zero, rounded to the cent. Rounding happens once, on the further deposit.

The plan's resort deposit nights are those listed for each rate plan in the payment and guarantee terms; the nightly rate is the one on the reservation at the time the further deposit is worked out.

## Worked computation (hypothetical Flexible Rate reservation at an Ashbury Resort & Spa)

| Step | Figures | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Deposit collected at booking | 250.00 nightly rate, 1 night, 12% tax | 280.00 |
| Refunds, forfeits, transfers posted | none | 0.00 |
| Money held | 280.00 less 0.00 | 280.00 |
| Nightly rate on the reservation after a change | — | 285.00 |
| Deposit the reservation requires | 1 night multiplied by 285.00, multiplied by 1.12 | 319.20 |
| Further deposit | 319.20 less 280.00 | 39.20 |

## Further cases (hypothetical)

| Money held | Deposit the reservation requires | Further deposit |
|---|---|---|
| 280.00 | 280.00 | 0.00 |
| 280.00 | 268.80 | 0.00 — never below zero, and nothing is refunded |
| 0.00 (collection later refunded in full) | 319.20 | 319.20 |
| 280.00, plus a further deposit of 39.20 already collected | 319.20 | 0.00 |
